user.title: Adaptive Lighting Helpers
user.description: Registers the adaptive_lighting_helpers.compute_lighting_groups, compute_curve, and compute_scene_coverage services - nothing below is required for those. Optionally, fill in these five times to also get day-phase/curve sensors (morning_start, day_start, evening_start, night_start, adaptive_lighting, adaptive_lighting_curve) and a phase-override select, computed the same way, no separate helpers or YAML package needed. Leave them blank to set up just the services.

data.sticky_phase_override: Keep a manual phase override until cleared by hand (instead of self-clearing at the next phase boundary)

reconfigure.title: Adaptive Lighting Helpers
reconfigure.description: Update the day-phase/curve schedule times. Leave all five blank to remove the sensors and select entity.
